Definition: Canonical human-readable lifecycle state file for each deliverable, carrying Current State, Last Updated, and history.
Forward-only, actor-authorized movement of a deliverable between lifecycle states.
Ordering constraint that lifecycle states may only advance, never move backward, unless a human amends the record.
Git SHA-like immutable evidence (7-64 character hex token per PRD) required for transitions to CHECKING or ISSUED.
Lifecycle transition (to CHECKING or ISSUED) requiring non-delegable human approval evidence.
Enforcement that only SPEC Section 4.3 authorized actors may perform a given transition; unmapped actors fail closed.
Write-gated Chirality MCP tool that applies an authorized lifecycle transition with approval SHA where required.
Policy that denial from policy, path check, hook, governance, SDK deny rule, or human gate blocks status transition execution.
Principle that in-process Chirality MCP tools are transports that pass through the same permission, hook, path, redaction, and event logging policy as SDK built-ins, not a bypass.
Reference-hash warning state for `docs/PRD.md` in `_REFERENCES.md`; PRD-derived acceptance details are warned material until reconciled.
Accepted decomposition-family label in the deliverable context, distinct from the SOFTWARE runtime dispatch token.
